All the blame goes to Webster when his friends try to rob the Tracadero, their hangout.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Valentine's Day finds Tamera trying to "steal back" her hot date, and Ray and Lisa wondering if the other person is in love with them.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E17 — Paper or Plastic?
Tamera crosses the picket lines to work at a supermarket, but soon realizes that being a "scab" isn't all it's cracked up to be.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E18 — The Piano Lesson
Ray learns a "noteworthy" lesson in honesty when he "fibs" and tells a tone-deaf Tamera that she plays the piano well, and she winds up humiliating herself at a piano recital.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tia and Tamera trade places so that Tia can be with a cute guy in summer school and Tamera can "goof off" by taking Tia's spot as a camp counselor.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tamera learns how much she needs Tia's help when she runs for class president.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E1 — Good Vibrations?
A frustrated Moesha longs for a promotion from 'gopher' to writer at Vibe magazine but believes that her boss, Joe Scott, would rather she pay her dues with something other than her writing talent.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E2 — Fired Up
Eager to get on the fast track at Vibe Magazine, Moesha pretends to be a reporter to land a Maya Angelou interview.  But her ambition, coupled with Maya’s advice, leads Moesha down an entirely different path than she’d planned.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E3 — The Party’s Over (Here)
Unable to resist the temptations of college life, Moesha and Niecy become regulars on the party circuit, until their attendance at a late-night frat party takes its toll in more ways than one.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E4 — Mis-Directed Study
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E5 — Not My Pumpkin
Things get tense at the Mitchell house when Frank discovers Moesha has been taking birth control pills – and he’s the last to know.

S3 E12 — Country Cousins
When Mary and Lester go to the reading of his uncle's will, they are both surprised to learn they have distant cousins whom they've never met, and even more confused when they discover they are a different color.

S3 E13 — Shall We Dance
When Lester's old high school sweetheart comes to the neighborhood in search of a new home, Mary fears that she'll try to move in on more than just her turf.

S3 E14 — Snowbound
Suffering from a very cold winter spell, the residents of '227' invade Mary and Lester's apartment, which is one of two apartments with heat.

S3 E17 — Rapture
When Pearl finds out that Calvin is failing his history class, Mary, Rose and Lester each take turns as tutor-in-residence.
